speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment (MSE) will strengthen Singapore’s environmental sustainability efforts and climate adaptation plans, even as we strive to uplift the daily environmental experiences of Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Global cooperation around responding to climate change is weakening.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: This heightens the risks that global warming could impose on our infrastructure, economy and society.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The NAP will serve as our long-term roadmap outlining actions that we will collectively take with Singaporeans to enhance our climate resilience.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will increase investments in science and technology to identify innovative and effective solutions to manage the effects of heat on our population and protect lives and livelihoods.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will press on with research efforts to develop new coastal protection technologies and solutions while learning from the best-in-class internationally.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Global food supply chains face will increasingly be disrupted by disease outbreaks, extreme weather events and heightened geopolitical uncertainty.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Internationally, we will work with partners to develop mitigation measures such as the carbon credits market and carbon capture, utilisation and storage solutions, including conducting carbon capture trials for our Waste-to-Energy plants.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MSE will invest in building Singapore’s capacity to assess the safety of nuclear energy options.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: As regional countries explore the use of nuclear energy, we will strengthen regional and international civil nuclear cooperation and enhance our incident response capabilities, including in collaboration with the International Atomic Energy Agency.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: As Singapore’s only landfill, Semakau Landfill, continues to fill up, Singapore must make greater strides to reduce, reuse and recycle.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MSE will work with industry to reduce waste disposal, improve recycling and explore better ways to reuse waste residues.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will launch our Beverage Container Return Scheme in partnership with the beverage industry.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MSE continues to work with partners and the community to improve public hygiene.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will target persistent littering and rat issues by tackling hotspots with technology, upstream refuse management and stronger enforcement.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MSE will harness new technologies, particularly artificial intelligence and data analytics, to improve our operations and better serve Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Our programmes such as the SG Eco Fund and Go Green SG connect and support communities, corporates, non-governmental organisations and schools to embrace sustainable lifestyles and contribute to climate action.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Together, we will work towards ensuring a greener, more liveable and climate resilient Singapore.
